description: This file defines the DbUpdateController class for handling Drupal database update routes, including functions for displaying update info, selecting updates, executing batch updates, and showing results.

classes.name: DbUpdateController
classes.description: Controller for managing Drupal database update routes, including displaying update info, handling update operations, and rendering update pages.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the controller with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to handle different update operations based on the request parameter.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays the database update information page.

methods.name: selection
methods.description: Displays list of available database updates for selection.

methods.name: results
methods.description: Displays the results of the update process, including errors and logs.

methods.name: requirements
methods.description: Displays requirement check results before proceeding with updates.

methods.name: updateTasksList
methods.description: Provides the render array for the update task list.

methods.name: triggerBatch
methods.description: Starts the batch process to perform database updates.

methods.name: batchFinished
methods.description: Static callback to finalize the batch update, store results, and restore site state.

methods.name: helpfulLinks
methods.description: Provides helpful links related to the update process.

methods.name: getModuleUpdates
methods.description: Retrieves the list of modules with pending updates.
